claimCeiling: The atlas records declared classifications, citations and dependencies. A displayed connection does not establish correctness, novelty, priority, independent confirmation, causal influence or real-world impact.

knowledgeStatuses.asserted: A named repository field explicitly records the relationship.
knowledgeStatuses.computed: A deterministic rule proposes a structural relationship from declared inputs; it remains distinct from an asserted scholarly relationship.
knowledgeStatuses.proposed: A person or agent has nominated a relationship for review; it is not part of the accepted Evidence Press graph.

predicates.label: uses method
predicates.meaning: The method registry assigns the release to this reusable method.
predicates.inferenceLimit: Assignment means that the release illustrates the method; it does not validate the method or the research result.

predicates.label: shares broad cluster
predicates.meaning: The method registry places the release in a broad operational or thematic cluster.
predicates.inferenceLimit: A cluster is not an evidence-backed dependency, common provenance, independent confirmation or research lineage.

predicates.label: belongs to lineage
predicates.meaning: The release is an explicitly registered member of an evidence-backed research programme.
predicates.inferenceLimit: Lineage reuse is correlated evidence, not independent confirmation; a shared defect can propagate through the programme.

predicates.label: extends result
predicates.meaning: The child release explicitly declares that it extends a bounded result from the parent.
predicates.inferenceLimit: The child inherits the stated assurance ceiling and is not independent confirmation of the parent.

predicates.label: reuses method
predicates.meaning: The release explicitly declares reuse of a method or workflow from another release.
predicates.inferenceLimit: Method reuse does not transfer correctness, review or impact evidence between releases.

predicates.label: cites related release
predicates.meaning: The release metadata cites another Evidence Press release as related work.
predicates.inferenceLimit: A citation records an authored relationship claim; it does not by itself establish dependence, priority, agreement or correctness.

proposalPolicy.publicationRule: Proposed and computed relationships must remain visually and machine-readably distinct. A proposal enters the asserted graph only through an additive reviewed record with a resolvable source basis.

rules: Generate method, cluster, lineage, parent and internal-citation edges from their canonical source records; do not duplicate them manually here.
Do not infer dependence, priority, correctness, agreement or common provenance from topical or lexical similarity.
Do not silently promote a computed or proposed relationship to asserted.
Retain rejected and superseded proposals with their review state when proposals are first published.
Use a new predicate identifier for a semantic replacement rather than redefining a published predicate in place.

changeLog.summary: Established the Evidence Atlas predicate vocabulary, three-way knowledge-status boundary and empty prospective proposal register; all first-release edges are generated from existing repository assertions.
